Subject: Private VPC pricing and token volumes — follow-up

Thanks for taking the call this morning, Alice — great conversation. Quick recap + next steps from our side: 

- Goal: Understand your expected token volumes and procurement timing so we can model Private/VPC pricing (license + support + committed usage) and recommended environment count.
- From the call: you expect to start with a pilot in Q4 and expand into production in H1 2029. Key constraints: strict data locality (VPC), PCI scope for payments team, and desire for a predictable monthly cost.

Actions we committed to: 
1) Share an initial pricing summary (attached) showing 3 licensing options (per-instance, per-seat license, and enterprise flat fee) + committed token tiers.
2) Call out unit economics at a few token-volume points (1M, 10M, 100M tokens) so you can map to your internal budget.
3) Recommend support tiers and environment counts for pilot -> prod.

Can you confirm the ballpark monthly token volume range you were thinking (pilot vs full prod), and how many isolated VPC environments you'll require (prod/staging/dev vs multiple prod clusters)? That will let me firm up the numbers.

Attaching: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Summary.pdf and our VPC topology diagram.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up if that's easier.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — PDF received and initial pass looks helpful. A few clarifications from our side to help you price accurately: 

- Pilot (Q4): ~50M tokens/month (inference tokens; roughly 20% context / 80% generation split).
- Target full prod (H1 2029): 150M–200M tokens/month assuming wider rollout to customer support and fraud workflows.
- Our target blended cost: looking to land somewhere between $30–$50 per 1M tokens (total landed cost) for forecasting — open to trade-offs between a higher fixed license + lower $/1M or vice-versa.
- Environments: we need 3 isolated VPC environments to start (prod, staging, dev). If we run multiple prod clusters later for regional separation, that would be additional. For initial pricing please assume 3 environments.
- Support: Must have 24/7 on-call and SLA for P1s during production. We're interested in the Gold support tier equivalent (TTR commitments).

Also attaching the completed security questionnaire excerpt and the MAT answers (FintechCo_MAL-answers.xlsx) you requested.

If you can sketch two commercial options (A: lower license + higher committed token rate; B: higher license + deeper committed discount) with approximate monthly costs at 50M and 175M tokens that would be ideal. We have a procurement window in late Oct and will need an SOW/MSA and cost sheet to move forward.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick screen share tomorrow afternoon if helpful.

Best,
Alice Zhou
Head of Data Products, FintechCo
alice.zhou@fintechco.com | +1 646-555-2323

Appreciate the detail, Alice — that's exactly what we needed. Attached is an updated pricing sketch based on your ranges (see Redwood_Private_Pricing_Summary.pdf v1.1). High level: 

Option A — Lower license + committed token tiers
- License: $25k/month (per-customer private control plane)
- Support: Gold (24/7, 1hr P1 initial response, dedicated CSM) = $15k/month
- Committed usage tiers / unit economics (inference only):
  * 50M tokens/mo: effective $/1M = $48 (monthly committed cost modeled)
  * 175M tokens/mo: effective $/1M = $34
- Notes: tiered discounts at 100M and 250M; additional environments add a per-environment fence of $5k/month for isolated VPCs.

Option B — Higher license + deeper committed discount
- License: $75k/month (enterprise flat fee incl. one dedicated control plane instance and extended audit retention)
- Support: Gold included
- Committed usage tiers / unit economics:
  * 50M tokens/mo: effective $/1M = $40
  * 175M tokens/mo: effective $/1M = $28
- Notes: best for customers planning >200M/month; includes a 12-month commitment discount and waived setup fees.

Environment assumptions: pricing above assumes 3 environments (prod, staging, dev). If you require multiple prod clusters for regional isolation we'll price those separately (roughly +$5k–$12k per additional prod cluster depending on capacity).

Next steps I propose: 
1) I'll send a one-page commercial summary and redlineable MSA/ordering guide (DocuSign link below) for your procurement team.
2) If the numbers look good, schedule a procurement alignment call (Ben + Marissa + your procurement lead) — we can lock final licensing and committed tokens.
3) Engineering/CS will scope a short pilot (2–4 weeks) to validate perf and connectivity in your VPC.
